title: iPawcus: A Web-Based Veterinary Management System with Online Booking and Pet Record Management for Vetfocus Care Animal Clinic

events.text: Sign in independently; authorize each role and request
events.detail: Every role signs in independently. Registration/email verification, login, account status and protected API authorization are a shared interaction, not one login shared by four people. Each request still checks the applicable role and clinic/patient access. The existing dashboard debug bypass is not changed by this documentation.

events.text: Manage accounts, roles and clinic assignments

evidence.needle: Only Super Admin can assign clinics

events.explanation: Super Admin determines the staff clinic assignments. Account activation/deactivation and role-specific professional data remain part of this summarized account operation.
This represents related persistence operations, not a new all-in-one SQL statement.

events.text: Set site acceptance and separate online slots
events.explanation: Onsite acceptance is per assigned clinic. Online-call start selections are separate; veterinarian presence today is not an onsite booking-hours calendar.
Saving preferences cannot abandon protected existing bookings. One veterinarian cannot overlap medical services across clinics and online calls.
Owner/co-parent access remains validated; an ownership request is not automatically accepted for someone else's pet.
Registration and ownership links are separate supporting records, summarized at the system boundary.
The result can be a saved pet, existing link or pending co-parent approval; approval steps are retained in the explanation.

branches.guard: Scheduled service request; walk-ins skip booking

events.explanation: The owner chooses the relevant clinic/service or the online veterinarian before checking availability.

Onsite medical capacity follows clinic hours and eligible veterinarians, not overlapping independent medical-service capacities. Online calls use separate selected slots. Grooming and boarding keep their own slot/room rules.
Unavailable or conflicting choices are rejected; the user can select another option.

Includes service concern and applicable upload/payment details. Payment proof applies where required, not to every booking. Optional home-service address lookup is R2. Failed validation does not create a valid booking.

Medical bookings reserve a veterinarian when created, before confirmation. This avoids displaying four patients against only three accepting veterinarians. Nonmedical services reserve their own applicable capacity, not a veterinarian.

events.text: Review booking / payment; confirm or adjust
events.explanation: Admin may reject, reschedule, transfer clinic or adjust assignment through the authorized endpoints. The main trace shows an accepted/confirmed request, not all error alternatives.
Database persistence precedes the displayed booking result and resulting notification.
This is a user-facing result/status event, not an acknowledgement from an unrelated owner session. Notification delivery and navigation are R2.
An approved queue and assigned veterinarian are required. A booked arrival uses receiveBooking; a walk-in uses the queue flow. Staff start physical examination, not the pet owner.
Intake preserves examined-by staff independently of the assigned veterinarian and links the same pet/queue context.
Represents the automatic GET-backed visible refresh. It does not invent a server push endpoint; My List is today-only, and future bookings remain in To-dos/next-day preview.
This is the owner's signing interaction administered by staff; it does not assume the owner has permission to call the admin intake endpoint.

events.text: Save findings / images / consent; reassign if needed / complete exam

evidence.needle: Capture and save the pet owner consent

events.explanation: Summarizes complaint, symptoms, urgent signs, vitals, physical findings and uploaded images. Admin can reassign the veterinarian before completion. Linked consent must already be saved before completing the intake.
These are coordinated steps from separate existing endpoints, not a claim of one atomic combined intake/consent API.

events.text: Finalize diagnosis / treatment; consent if needed
events.explanation: Veterinarian review retains exam provenance, assessment, laboratory findings, treatment, follow-up and optional additional consent. Starting examination is not the same as completing diagnosis.
Clinical finalization includes existing transaction/visit/invoice integration. Prescription synchronization, when needed, is summarized by the following guarded fragment.
The veterinarian starts the scheduled call; the patient does not need an onsite intake.
System verifies booking/participant access and records join status before the authorized meeting UI is opened.

events.text: R2: Jitsi / JaaS meeting access and video call
events.detail: The configured meeting provider carries the actual video exchange. Meeting access and participants remain authorized; no single self-hosted deployment is assumed.

events.explanation: Includes medications where entered; completing the online diagnosis also completes the consultation/booking and prepares its visit billing.
Online diagnoses synchronize prescription plans in the existing backend. A cancelled/no-show call follows a different status path, not a successful diagnostic result.

events.text: Run care job / room stay; record care
events.explanation: Grooming has receive/before photo/start/after photo/finish/pickup states; boarding has room assignment, check-in, observations, tasks, documents/materials and check-out. These are alternative care types, not required steps of an online or medical visit.

Required care evidence and applicable capacity checks remain. Grooming finishing prepares/reuses an invoice but does not mark it paid. A requested vet review pauses grooming and does not create a diagnosis or consultation charge automatically.

events.text: R5: Care updates; vet review if requested; discharge / pickup after checks
events.detail: Admin requests the assigned veterinarian's review only when necessary. Boarding checkout and grooming pickup retain the current workflow/payment restrictions; no automatic discharge is invented.

branches.guard: Diagnosis contains new / changed medicines (onsite or online)

events.text: Sync pet plan / items; retain versions
events.explanation: This is part of the diagnostic finalization persistence, shown after the shared diagnostic branches for concision. A changed plan supersedes the previous plan and cancels its pending occurrences while retaining history. Empty content creates no new plan.
Notification follows persisted changed content and directs the owner to the relevant pet prescription plan. Unchanged content does not generate a replacement version.

No prescription means no automatic printing. Printing does not depend on creating a changed prescription version. The current online flow issues prescriptions but is not falsely claimed to use the onsite automatic-print handler.

branches.guard: Owner starts available prescription item(s), new or existing

events.text: Start items / all; dates per item
events.explanation: Each medicine can start separately with its own start date, frequency, time slots/weekday rules and duration. Start all applies selected item settings rather than forcing one shared schedule.
Daily/hourly/weekly recurrences are generated for each medicine, not one combined schedule for every item. Three-times-daily defaults can use morning, noon and evening.
The response displays due occurrences and completion state. Starting a plan does not mark its doses completed.

events.text: Post charges / verify and record payment
events.explanation: Catalogue services, medicines/products, material charges and applicable care fees remain separately auditable. A submitted proof is not automatically a verified payment.
Only applicable sale/material operations affect stock. Refunds use the authorized refund endpoint and preserve payment/refund history rather than overwriting a sale.
Receipt/print helpers are inside the system boundary (R2). The owner is shown the relevant invoice and payment/refund status.

branches.guard: Each due occurrence of a started prescription item

events.explanation: Each due item/date/time can be completed or skipped independently. This loop runs later when doses are due, not while the veterinarian remains in one long active session.
Updates a specific occurrence and plan status; other medicines and future doses are not marked completed automatically.
This operation is invoked independently of a particular appointment. The backend builds filtered data; the interface generates PDF or Excel files when requested.
Reporting reads relevant stored clinical, booking, financial and inventory records; it does not create a second reporting database.
The view/export result returns to the requesting Super Admin. Monitoring and backups remain separately invoked R4 interactions.

events.text: View / email records; correction: Owner → Admin review → Vet update → Owner result
events.detail: Reading/emailing an accessible medical record and requesting a correction are different interactions. A pet owner does not directly replace a verified veterinarian record.

events.text: Independent operations: stock / settings / reports / monitoring / backups
events.detail: These are separately invoked operations, not mandatory steps of every appointment. Combining them in a reference avoids pretending that an Admin stock entry must always be followed by a Super Admin export or backup.

events.text: Supporting services: location / notifications / documents (invoked when needed)
events.detail: These are deliberately not additional lifelines in the overview. No fictional single external service is invented. Notifications, location lookup, meetings and documents remain different mechanisms inside or beyond the system boundary.

Diagnosis contains new / changed medicines (onsite or online)
Owner starts available prescription item(s), new or existing
Each due occurrence of a started prescription item

R2: JITSI / JAAS MEETING ACCESS AND VIDEO CALL
RUN CARE JOB / ROOM STAY; RECORD CARE
R5: CARE UPDATES; VET REVIEW IF REQUESTED; DISCHARGE / PICKUP AFTER CHECKS
